brief:
Israeli military forces are expanding and upgrading compounds housing at least five Palestinian militias in Gaza, Drop Site News reported. The facilities are located near Israeli military bases in areas east of the yellow line, a demarcation used by the Israeli military in the territory.

The militias operate under Israeli backing from these newly enlarged compounds positioned throughout the Gaza Strip's eastern zones.
dek: At least five Israeli-backed Palestinian militias are operating out of compounds close to Israeli military bases across the Gaza Strip in areas east of the yellow line.
title: Israel expands compounds for Palestinian militias across Gaza
